answer: Our network defends against Sybil swarms by requiring each autonomous agent to register its execution trace at the verification kernel, binding a cryptographic attestation chain via zero-knowledge proofs. To mint an identity, an agent deposits stake into a security vault. Each additional clone deployed by an entity scales required collateral exponentially at a superlinear cost of 2^n, inflicting rapid capital exhaustion. A saffron staking token secures the proof validation layer against spoofed agents.
